posts.title: Sites that speak for themselves: an agent endpoint for every small website
posts.description: An idea for an open-source tool that lets a small website answer AI agents, its search box and a chat window from one index built when it is published.

posts.title: An OS for AI agents: not the one on your laptop
posts.description: An idea for running a fleet of personal AI agents: not an operating system per agent, but one small host that holds what each agent may call, spend and do.

posts.title: An AI-first CMS: AI operates, people govern
posts.description: An idea for a CMS built the other way round: the AI does the work by default, and people write the rules and review what matters before it goes live.
